description.value: Mad Rona's Coffee Bar is a contemporary west coast-inspired café located at Madrona Marketplace East on Gabriola Island, just walking distance from the BC Ferries terminal. The café serves house-made sandwiches, paninis, and scratch-baked goods alongside quality espresso sourced from Cobble Hill's Drumroaster Coffee, roasted in small batches and delivered fresh weekly. A licensed patio and free Wi-Fi make it a welcoming and practical stop for cyclists exploring the island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms a contemporary west coast café at 500 North Rd, Gabriola Island, near the BC Ferries terminal, with explicitly stated free Wi-Fi and a licensed patio. OSM tags (internet_access=yes, internet_access:fee=no, outdoor_seating=yes) align with website claims. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM website URL points to the /menu/ subpage rather than the site homepage; minor but worth normalizing to the root URL.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active café walking distance from the Gabriola Island ferry terminal with free Wi-Fi, a licensed outdoor patio, and a full house-made food menu — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian items (Falafel Wrap, Veggie Patty with house-made patty and mozzarella, multiple veggie paninis); website states 'All sandwiches can be made on a gluten free wrap or bun.'
